verses.text: This is the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

xrefs.text: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
In the third year of the reign of Hoshea son of Elah over Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz became king of Judah.

verses.text: Listen, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for the LORD has spoken: “I have raised children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against Me.

xrefs.text: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
Hear, O peoples, all of you; listen, O earth, and everyone in it! May the Lord GOD bear witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple.

I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.
He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:

verses.text: The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s manger, but Israel does not know; My people do not understand.”

xrefs.text: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons. The turtledove, the swift, and the thrush keep their time of migration, but My people do not know the requirements of the LORD.
“For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.”
They do not comprehend or discern, for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see and closed their minds so they cannot understand.
This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine. They disregard the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands.

verses.text: Alas, O sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a brood of evildoers, children who act corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD; they have despised the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on Him.

xrefs.text: Therefore, as a tongue of fire consumes the straw, and as dry grass shrivels in the flame, so their roots will decay and their blossoms will blow away like dust; for they have rejected the instruction of the LORD of Hosts and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
Have you not brought this on yourself by forsaking the LORD your God when He led you in the way?
“For My people have committed two evils: They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living water, and they have dug their own cisterns— broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.

Your own evil will discipline you; your own apostasies will reprimand you. Consider and realize how evil and bitter it is for you to forsake the LORD your God and to have no fear of Me,” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.

verses.text: Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.

xrefs.text: O LORD, we are covered with shame— our kings, our leaders, and our fathers— because we have sinned against You.
Because of the indecency of your uncleanness I tried to cleanse you, but you would not be purified from your filthiness. You will not be pure again until My wrath against you has subsided.
Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given power to scorch the people with fire.

O LORD, do not Your eyes look for truth? You struck them, but they felt no pain. You finished them off, but they refused to accept discipline. They have made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent.
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority. My people love it so, but what will you do in the end?

verses.text: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head, there is no soundness— only wounds and welts and festering sores neither cleansed nor bandaged nor soothed with oil.

xrefs.text: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
Nevertheless, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.
There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.text: Your land is desolate; your cities are burned with fire. Foreigners devour your fields before you— a desolation demolished by strangers.

xrefs.text: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.
Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
Foreigners consume his strength, but he does not notice. Even his hair is streaked with gray, but he does not know.
I will make the streams dry up and sell the land to the wicked. By the hands of foreigners I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it. I, the LORD, have spoken.

verses.text: And the Daughter of Zion is abandoned like a shelter in a vineyard, like a shack in a cucumber field, like a city besieged.

xrefs.text: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
“Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”
“Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD.

Yet today they will halt at Nob, shaking a fist at the mount of Daughter Zion, at the hill of Jerusalem.

verses.text: Unless the LORD of Hosts had left us a few survivors, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.

And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah will again take root below and bear fruit above.

verses.text: Hear the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

xrefs.text: The expression on their faces testifies against them, and like Sodom they flaunt their sin; they do not conceal it. Woe to them, for they have brought disaster upon themselves.
Now this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed, and complacent; they did not help the poor and needy.
Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city— figuratively called Sodom and Egypt— where their Lord was also crucified.
But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter.

Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab, and all the inhabitants of the desert who clip the hair of their temples. For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”

verses.text: “What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.

xrefs.text: But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
“I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.
What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please Me.”

Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man; whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol. Indeed, they have chosen their own ways and delighted in their abominations.
Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

verses.text: When you come to appear before Me, who has required this of you— this trampling of My courts?

xrefs.text: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.
“Cry aloud, do not hold back! Raise your voice like a ram’s horn. Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins.
Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.

verses.text: Bring your worthless offerings no more; your incense is detestable to Me. New Moons, Sabbaths, and convocations — I cannot endure iniquity in a solemn assembly.

They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’

And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.

He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.

verses.text: I hate your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They have become a burden to Me; I am weary of bearing them.

xrefs.text: “I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.
You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
Then Isaiah said, “Hear now, O house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of men? Will you try the patience of my God as well?
For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
Woe to you, O Ariel, the city of Ariel where David camped! Year upon year let your festivals recur.

verses.text: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.

xrefs.text: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.
But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He does not hear.
Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
And just as I had called and they would not listen, so when they called I would not listen, says the LORD of Hosts.

verses.text: Wash and cleanse yourselves. Remove your evil deeds from My sight. Stop doing evil!

xrefs.text: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

verses.text: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor. Defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow.”

xrefs.text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

This is what the LORD says: Administer justice and righteousness. Rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Do not shed innocent blood in this place.
Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy.
Your rulers are rebels, friends of thieves. They all love bribes and chasing after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, and the plea of the widow never comes before them.

verses.text: “Come now, let us reason together,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.

xrefs.text: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
“Sir, I answered, “you know. So he replied, “These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.

verses.text: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.

xrefs.text: See, I have set before you today life and prosperity, as well as death and disaster.
Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.

verses.text: Your silver has become dross; your fine wine is diluted with water.

xrefs.text: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.
How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
All are hardened rebels, walking around as slanderers. They are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
When their liquor is gone, they turn to prostitution; their rulers dearly love disgrace.
What shall I do with you, O Ephraim What shall I do with you, O Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes.

verses.text: Your rulers are rebels, friends of thieves. They all love bribes and chasing after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, and the plea of the widow never comes before them.

Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’

verses.text: Therefore the Lord GOD of Hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: “Ah, I will be relieved of My foes and avenge Myself on My enemies.

xrefs.text: You will drink the milk of nations and nurse at the breasts of royalty; you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

And when My anger is spent and I have vented My wrath against them, I will be appeased. And when I have spent My wrath on them, they will know that I, the LORD, in My zeal have spoken.

when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the bloodstains from the heart of Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.
